data.name: California Sunset Tour
data.headline: Guided sunset bike ride from San Francisco piers across the Golden Gate Bridge with coastal views and historic stops.
data.description: Enjoy a professionally guided sunset bike tour that follows San Francisco’s scenic coastline from the piers through Crissy Field and past Fort Point to the Golden Gate Bridge. Ride on the west/ocean side of the bridge, open to cyclists after 3pm, then continue across and explore lesser-known roads, historic monuments and graveyards that reveal the city’s past. The tour offers photo opportunities, coastal breezes and a relaxed pace suited to families and beginners while highlighting local history and iconic views.
data.highlights:
* Sunset views of the Golden Gate Bridge and San Francisco coastline
* Photo opportunities at iconic piers, Crissy Field and Fort Point
* Ride the west/ocean side of the bridge when open to cyclists
* Historic monuments and graveyards showcasing the city’s past
data.itinerary:
Guided Bike Tour with Bay City Bike Rentals and Tours (Up to 3 hours):

* Meet your guide at 📍 2661 Taylor Street TOUR CENTER in Fisherman’s Wharf
* Bike fitting and safety orientation
* Fisherman’s Wharf waterfront
* Pass through the Marina District
* Ride along Crissy Field
* Ride aross the Golden Gate Bridge on the west/ocean side (photo stop)
* Visit Presidio park 
* Return 📍 2661 Taylor Street

data.cancellation_notes:
**Cancellation and No-Show Policy:** 

• Cancellations made 72 hours prior to reservation date & time are fully refunded. Cancellations within 72 hours of reserved date & time are charged in full, and considered non-refundable. No-shows are charged in full, and considered non-refundable. All Alcatraz packages are non-refundable once booked. Please refer to your Alcatraz confirmation for confirmation/cancellation details. 

**Changed Reservation Date Policy:**

• If a reservation date is changed from its original date, the changed reservation disqualifies the above cancellation policy. The changed reservation date is charged in full, is considered non-refundable, and is charged in full.

**Reservation Terms & Conditions:**

• Reservation is valid for redemption for bikes/equipment/tours noted on this invoice receipt. It is not transferable, has no cash value, and may be redeemed only once.
data.booking_notes:
Thank you for choosing Bay City Bike Rentals & Tours! This is a confirmation for your reservation.

The California Sunset Tour departs promptly at **4pm March-October and 3pm November-February.** Please arrive at least 30 minutes earlier to our **2661 Taylor Street TOUR CENTER** location in Fisherman's Wharf.

**Redemption Instructions**
•	Please bring a valid ID and a Credit Card with you to pick up your bikes.
•	We take a monetary authorization on all rentals, starting at $100. The authorized amount is held until we have the safe return of all rental equipment. The various amounts required for bike types is as follows: $100 City Bike; $200 Performance; $300 Tandem; $500 Electric bike; $700 Road Aluminum; $1,200 Road Carbon.
data.check_in_details: Arrive 30 minutes before the tour start time at 2661 Taylor Street tour center in Fisherman's Wharf.
data.special_requirements:
All riders are required to sign a liability waiver prior to riding. Guests under 18 must have a parent or legal guardian present to sign on their behalf and accompany them at check-in.

If you book online, you’ll receive an electronic waiver to complete in advance. Walk-in guests will complete the waiver during check-in before the rental begins.
data.disclaimers: West/ocean side of the Golden Gate Bridge opens to cyclists at 3pm; access to that side is subject to that schedule.
data.faqs:
What time does the bike tour leave?
The tour departs at available time, please call us at (415) 346-2453. We ask that all guests arrive at least 30 minutes early to complete paperwork and be fitted for their bikes. The tour is approximately 8 miles and lasts up to 3 hours. The tour departs from our Fisherman’s Wharf Tour Center, located at 2661 Taylor Street.
Is there a bike path across the Golden Gate Bridge?
Yes. The Golden Gate Bridge has dedicated bike access, with cyclists sharing one side of the bridge depending on the day and time. The path is clearly marked and well-maintained. Our Golden Gate Bridge tours provide up-to-date guidance on which side to ride and ensure a safe, stress-free crossing.
What's included with a Bay City Bike guided bike tour of San Francisco?
In addition to fabulous routes led by local guides, we provide your bike rental, helmet, a front camera bag, bells, maps and map holders, water bottle holders, and locks. We also have kid equipment options.
Is Bay City Bike open daily?
We are open 365 days a year, rain or shine. We suggest booking your tour ahead of time though, as spots can fill up quick. We also offer a 20% discount if you book online!
